referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of a ventilation system for a school with schoolrooms, gym, public library and multi-purpose hall. The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 5607 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 35300 m3/h, total weight of the components: 12842 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 6.3 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air handling units, ducts including insulation, air valves, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers. The data represent a ductwork made of galvanized steel and polyethylene tubes. It includes air handling units mainly with heat recovery. System with central air handling units. Building without ground heat exchanger.; UUID: fdb97f74-b62a-39be-ae11-fd3f958070b2
